description:
Fetch the result of a transcription started by audio-transcribe, using its jobId. Returns the finished transcript with time-coded segments, or the current progress while it is still running. Job ids are kept for 24 hours.

upAPI operation `audio-transcribe-result.get` (Media). Costs 1 unit of monthly quota per call.

jobId.description: The jobId returned by audio-transcribe (e.g. upapi-3f9c1d2e4b5a…).
jobId.title: Jobid

name: audio_transcribe_result_get
title: Get Transcription Result
